reviews.title: 100% worth the upgrade
reviews.comment: Massive upgrade, i used to have a Dell P2222H, it was 27”, great monitor, but man, this is a HUGE upgrade. the image quality is very crisp, it works well with wallpaper engine and i LOVE that it’s price is less than a 27 inch LG monitor, lowkey, 2 HDMI ports, 1 displayport, and 1 aux port on the monitor makes things super easy, i can use my google chromecast and then switch to my PC, not having to mess around with any audio or display cables, once you set it, it’s done. it has such a nice appearance, it looks as if it were high class, and the monitor is hella responsive, would i suggest this? yes, yes i would, you get a 34” monitor for about $200
reviews.author: Asal

reviews.title: Just buy it already
reviews.comment: Good monitor at a great price. I've used this with both macOS and Windows and it works perfectly in both. Color accuracy is good as is viewing angles. Contrast and black levels are pretty good for most things. The built-in speakers aren't worth using and sound terrible. I use it with a monitor mount and would recommend that because the included stand is wobbly. Great for text, programming, spreadsheets and watching videos. Light gaming is perfectly fine on it too and it has 100 Hz refresh rate which is nice.
reviews.author: Mack Tech

reviews.title: Perfect screen for my tower
reviews.comment: Using it right now to write this review. I love the size and how easy it was to hook up to my computer. My wife stole my dual screens for her job, that I actually stole from her first, so I guess we are even. I was able to replace them with just one screen. Love it.
